def Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.leftNeighbors (E : Finset (Prod Nat Nat)) (p : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun E p => Finset.image Prod.fst (Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (Prod.snd e) p) E)

core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.rightNeighbors (E : Finset (Prod Nat Nat)) (p : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun E p => Finset.image Prod.snd (Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (Prod.fst e) p) E)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.graphNeighbors
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.graphNeighbors (E : Finset (Prod Nat Nat)) (p : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  fun E p =>
  Union.union (Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.rightNeighbors E p)
    (Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.leftNeighbors E p)

def Erdos306.PrimeResidueAndRowPotential.incidenceDegree.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset (Prod α α))
  (v : α) : Nat :=
  fun {α} [DecidableEq α] E v =>
  HAdd.hAdd (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (Prod.fst e) v) E))
    (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (Prod.snd e) v) E))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306 :
  Iff True
    (∀ (q : Rat),
      LT.lt 0 q →
        Squarefree (Rat.den q) →
          Exists fun k =>
            Exists fun n =>
              And (Eq (n 0) 1)
                (And (StrictMono n)
                  (And
                    (∀ (i : Fin (HAdd.hAdd k 1)),
                      Membership.mem (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) i →
                        And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors (n i)) 2)
                          (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (n i)) 2))
                    (Eq q (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) fun i => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑(n i))))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_formal_conjectures
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_formal_conjectures (q : Rat) :
  LT.lt 0 q →
    Squarefree (Rat.den q) →
      Exists fun k =>
        Exists fun n =>
          And (Eq (n 0) 1)
            (And (StrictMono n)
              (And
                (∀ (i : Fin (HAdd.hAdd k 1)),
                  Membership.mem (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) i →
                    And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors (n i)) 2)
                      (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (n i)) 2))
                (Eq q (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) fun i => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑(n i)))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_variants_integer_three_primes
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_variants_integer_three_primes (m : Nat) (h : LT.lt 0 m) :
  Exists fun k =>
    And (GT.gt k 0)
      (Exists fun n =>
        And (Eq (n 0) 1)
          (∀ (i : Nat) (hik : LT.lt i k),
            And (LT.lt (n ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hik⟩) (n ⟨HAdd.hAdd i 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hik⟩))
              (And
                (∀ (i : Fin (HAdd.hAdd k 1)),
                  Membership.mem (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) i →
                    And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors (n i)) 3)
                      (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (n i)) 3))
                (Eq (↑m) (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 (Fin.last k)) fun i => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑(n i))))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_finset_omega_Omega
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.erdos_306_finset_omega_Omega (q : Rat) (hq : LT.lt 0 q) (hsq : Squarefree (Rat.den q)) :
  Exists fun F =>
    And
      (∀ (n : Nat),
        Membership.mem F n →
          And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n) 2)
            (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) 2))
      (Eq (Finset.sum F fun n => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑n) q)

core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.integer_three_primes_finset (m : Nat) (hm : LT.lt 0 m) :
  Exists fun F =>
    And
      (∀ (n : Nat),
        Membership.mem F n →
          And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n) 3)
            (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) 3) (LT.lt 1 n)))
      (Eq (↑m) (Finset.sum F fun n => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑n))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos306.Palomar.exists_semiprime_set_sum_eq_one_iff_ten_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.exists_semiprime_set_sum_eq_one_iff_ten_le (d : Nat) :
  Iff
    (Exists fun S =>
      And
        (∀ (n : Nat),
          Membership.mem S n →
            And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n) 2)
              (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) 2))
        (And (∀ (p : Nat), Nat.Prime p → LE.le (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun n => Dvd.dvd p n) S)) d)
          (Eq (Finset.sum S fun n => HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑n) 1)))
    (LE.le 10 d)

core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos306.Palomar.semiprime_set_card_ge_fifty_eight_of_sum_eq_one (S : Finset Nat)
  (hS :

      Membership.mem S n →
        And (Eq (DFunLike.coe ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n) 2)

  (hdeg : ∀ (p : Nat), Nat.Prime p → LE.le (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun n => Dvd.dvd p n) S)) 10)
